header.title: Vacademy Assistant
header.description: The in-app AI assistant for your team. Control which capabilities it can use for everyone, and grant extra capabilities to specific roles below. Access is always limited to this institute.

capabilities.title: Capabilities for everyone
capabilities.description: Enabled for every non-learner role in your institute.

perRole.title: Per-role access (advanced)
perRole.description: Grant extra capabilities to specific roles, on top of the institute-wide set above. Leave a role uncustomized to use the institute-wide settings.

toasts.presetApplied: Preset applied — click Save settings to confirm.

search_help_knowledge.label: Help & how-to guidance
search_help_knowledge.description: Answers “how do I / where do I” questions about using the portal, with step-by-step instructions.

learner_data.label: Learner data lookup
learner_data.description: Find learners by name/email/phone and answer questions about their attendance, assessment scores, activity, course progress and login summary — and generate their full analysis report. On by default for Admins; grant to other roles below.

payments.label: Payments & fees
payments.description: Answer questions about a learner’s payment history, outstanding/overdue fees, and payment plans. On by default for Admins.

batch_data.label: Batch rosters
batch_data.description: List the learners in a batch and answer batch headcount questions. On by default for Admins.

schedule.label: Class schedule
schedule.description: Answer “what classes are live/upcoming” and “what do I have today” from the live-session schedule. On by default for Admins.

institute_overview.label: Institute overview
institute_overview.description: Institute-wide snapshots: total overdue fees, live classes right now, active learner counts. On by default for Admins.

learner_edits.label: Learner edits (actions)
learner_edits.description: Let the assistant PROPOSE changes — edit a learner’s details, extend access, move batch, activate/deactivate. Every change requires the user to press Confirm on a card before anything is applied. On by default for Admins; other roles are opt-in.

assessments.label: Assessment results
assessments.description: Find assessments and answer questions about submissions, scores, pending evaluations, and leaderboards. On by default for Admins.

website_builder.label: Website: view
website_builder.description: See the institute’s websites — pages, what each section shows (which courses, which lead campaign), traffic, lead capture health and pre-publish checks — and run the interview needed before a site is generated. Read-only. On by default for Admins.

website_builder_edits.label: Website: edit drafts
website_builder_edits.description: Let the assistant build and change websites by conversation — compose pages, edit sections, set colours and fonts, wire forms to lead campaigns. Every change is saved as a draft; nothing goes live until you publish it in Manage Pages. Uses no AI credits. Off by default.

audience_forms.label: Lead forms: view
audience_forms.description: See lead campaigns (Audience Manager): their form fields, where they are used on the websites, leads received and recent leads. Read-only. On by default for Admins.

audience_forms_edits.label: Lead forms: edit
audience_forms_edits.description: Let the assistant create lead campaigns, add fields to their forms and send test leads. It never removes anything. Off by default.

announcements.label: Announcements
announcements.description: See planned/past announcements, and PROPOSE sending one to batches, roles, or specific learners — sending always requires pressing Confirm on a card. On by default for Admins.

workflows.label: Automations: view
workflows.description: See the institute’s automations (workflows): each one’s trigger or schedule, its nodes, recent runs and per-node results, plus the authoring catalog and the batches, lead campaigns and templates an automation can reference. Read-only. On by default for Admins.

workflows_edits.label: Automations: draft
workflows_edits.description: Let the assistant build automations by conversation — compose the workflow, check it against the builder’s rules, save it as a DRAFT, and create the new email and WhatsApp templates it needs (WhatsApp templates are sent to Meta for approval). A draft never runs until you open it in the builder and publish it; published automations and existing templates cannot be changed or removed from here. Uses no AI credits. Off by default.

crm_leads.label: CRM leads: view
crm_leads.description: Find leads and enquiries, see a lead’s details, timeline and today’s follow-ups, and export a list as a private download link. Each person sees only the leads the CRM shows them. Read-only. On by default for Admins and Counsellors.

crm_calls.label: CRM calls: view
crm_calls.description: See call logs, call transcripts, callbacks due, missed inbound calls and AI-calling status. Read-only. On by default for Admins and Counsellors.

crm_meetings.label: CRM meetings: view
crm_meetings.description: See your and your team’s meetings, a lead’s meetings, free slots and booking pages. Read-only. On by default for Admins and Counsellors.

crm_messages.label: CRM messages: view
crm_messages.description: See a lead’s WhatsApp and email history, the inbox, approved templates and escalations. Read-only. On by default for Admins and Counsellors.

crm_reports.label: CRM reports: view
crm_reports.description: Answer questions from the CRM reports — sources, funnel, counsellor performance, follow-ups, SLA, revenue and custom reports — each with its date range and definition. Read-only. On by default for Admins and Counsellors.

crm_collections.label: CRM payments: view
crm_collections.description: See admissions, a lead’s dues, who owes, what falls due and collections. Read-only. On by default for Admins and Counsellors.

crm_lead_activity.label: CRM leads: log activity and follow-ups
crm_lead_activity.description: Let the assistant PROPOSE logging a call, chat, visit or note on a lead, and scheduling, moving or completing follow-ups. Every change shows on a card first and is made only when the user presses Confirm. Opt-in: off until you switch it on.

crm_lead_edits.label: CRM leads: edit status, tier, details and tags
crm_lead_edits.description: Let the assistant PROPOSE changing lead status (one lead or many), tier, contact details, form answers and tags. The card lists each lead with what changes. A move to Converted follows your admission rule. Opt-in: off until you switch it on.

crm_lead_merges.label: CRM leads: merge duplicate people
crm_lead_merges.description: Let institute admins merge a person entered twice into the one to keep, or undo a merge, after confirming a card that shows both people. Opt-in: off until you switch it on.

crm_team_edits.label: CRM leads: assign and route
crm_team_edits.description: Let admins and team managers assign leads, move a counsellor’s leads to others and pause or resume a counsellor’s lead routing, after confirming a card. Opt-in: off until you switch it on.

crm_lead_intake.label: CRM leads: add leads
crm_lead_intake.description: Let the assistant add a lead (walk-ins and phone enquiries too) or import up to 100 into a lead list, after confirming a card. Existing and opted-out people are flagged. Opt-in: off until you switch it on.

crm_meeting_edits.label: CRM meetings: log outcomes
crm_meeting_edits.description: Let the assistant record whether a meeting with a lead was held or a no-show, after confirming a card. Booking meetings stays in the CRM (the lead receives an invite). Opt-in: off until you switch it on.
